checks.claim: InstructGPT hallucinates on closed-domain tasks about half as often as GPT-3: 21% against 41%
checks.recomputed: Figure 4: GPT 44.8%, PPO 21.6%, PPO-ptx 15.6%; Figure 30, GPT by size: 62%, 47%, 51%
checks.note: Roughly half holds, but 41% appears in neither figure; and Figure 4's pooled GPT and SFT rates lie below every per-size value in Figure 30, which a pooled average cannot do, so the two figures were drawn from different data.

checks.claim: InstructGPT generates about 25% fewer toxic outputs than GPT-3 when prompted to be respectful
checks.recomputed: Figure 7 (175B): 16% fewer by Perspective API, 20% by labelers; Table 14: 15%, 12%, 16% by size
checks.note: Every printed comparison gives 16% to 20% (or less at 6B); 25% may come from a subset (Figure 39 by prompt toxicity) the text does not name.

checks.claim: InstructGPT generates truthful and informative answers about twice as often as GPT-3 (TruthfulQA)
checks.recomputed: human labels (Figure 6, 175B, QA prompt): truthful 35.0% against 25.3% (1.38x), truthful and informative 29.5% against 19.8% (1.49x); automatic metric (Table 14): 0.689 against 0.251 (2.75x)
checks.note: Twice holds only on the automatic metric, which the acknowledgements say "overstat[ed] the gains of our PPO models"; the human evaluation in Figure 6 gives about 1.4x to 1.5x.
